rules.name: Revoked Agent Intercept
rules.message: Access denied: Agent is revoked or decommissioned.

rules.name: Unauthorized Scope Intercept
rules.message: Access denied: Agent lacks permission scope for this action.

rules.name: Transaction Hard Cap Exceeded
rules.message: Transaction blocked: Order amount exceeds hard maximum threshold of ₹15,000.

rules.name: Daily Spending Limit Hard Cap
rules.message: Transaction blocked: Cumulative 24-hour spend exceeds maximum limit of ₹25,000.

rules.name: Non-Returnable Category Check
rules.message: Return blocked: Category is non-returnable under Amazon India policy.

rules.name: Return Window Expired
rules.message: Return blocked: Exceeded standard Amazon India 7-day return window.

rules.name: High Value Purchase Step-Up Approval
rules.message: Customer approval required: Order amount exceeds automatic threshold of ₹2,000.

rules.name: Unverified Shipping Address
rules.message: Customer approval required: Delivery PIN code is not in saved verified addresses.

rules.name: High Risk Category Step-Up
rules.message: Customer approval required: Cart contains high-risk or restricted product category.

rules.name: High Value Refund Approval
rules.message: Customer approval required: Refund amount exceeds automatic threshold of ₹1,000.
